Radha Devi Jageshwari Memorial Medical College and Hospital, established in 2021, is a private medical college and hospital located at Muzaffarpur, Bihar, India. This college offers the Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery (MBBS) courses and has an annual intake capacity of 150. This college is affiliated with the Bihar University of Health Sciences and recognized by the National Medical Commission.
